data.title: Light that does not flicker
data.verse: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
body: Peter, James and John climbed the mountain expecting another ordinary prayer meeting. What they met was a light that came from the inside out. Jesus did not borrow His glory from the sun; the sun was simply the nearest picture they had for it.

Many of us live by reflected light. We shine when the week is good, when the bills are paid, when someone speaks well of us. Then a cloud passes and the brightness goes with it. That is borrowed light, and borrowed light always flickers.

The light God wants to grow in you does not depend on the weather around you. It is kindled in prayer, fed by the Word and protected by obedience. Today, before you check your phone, give the first ten minutes to Him.
Carry this into your day: I will not live on reflected light. The One who shone on the mountain lives in me.

data.title: Six days later
data.verse: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart.
body: Before the mountain there were six days. Six days of walking, of waiting, of ordinary bread and ordinary roads. Scripture does not tell us much about them, and that is the point. Glory is often prepared in days nobody writes about.
If you are in your six days, do not despise them. God is not late. He is preparing the climb, choosing the company and setting the time.

data.title: Staying on the mountain is not the assignment
data.verse: Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles.
body: Peter wanted to build tents and stay. Who can blame him? But the mountain was a meeting place, not a dwelling place. The boy who needed deliverance was at the bottom of the hill.
Every encounter with God comes with a descent. You are lifted so that you can carry something back down.

data.title: Hear ye him
data.verse: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
body: When the cloud came, the instruction was simple: hear Him. Not Moses first, not Elijah first, not our plans first. Him.
This season, the Lord is calling His people back to listening. Before you speak to the situation, let Him speak to you.

data.title: Jesus only
data.verse: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
body: When the vision ended, the disciples were not left empty. They were left with Jesus. When the lights of the service go off and the music stops, He remains.
Lift your eyes today and look past every other voice. What remains is enough.

data.title: Arise, shine
data.verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
body: Notice the order: the light comes first, then the command to shine. God never asks you to produce what He has not first provided.
Your part is to arise. Get up from the place of discouragement and let what He put in you be seen.

data.title: Our son came home
data.name: The Fon family
data.quote: He left home at 17. At 21 he walked back through our door.
body: A family’s story of four years of prayer and one phone call.

data.title: Set free from a habit I hid for ten years
data.name: Brother Samuel T.
data.quote: I am writing this so someone else knows freedom is possible.
body: For ten years I hid it from everyone, even my wife. During the midnight prayer line I finally confessed and asked for help.
It has been four months. I am free, and my home is at peace.

data.title: From closing my shop to opening a second one
data.name: Sister Mirabel A.
data.quote: In January I was ready to close. In October I opened a second branch.
body: Mirabel shares how she followed the counsel from the Prophet’s teaching on faithfulness in small things.

data.title: My visa was approved after it was refused twice
data.name: Daniel K.
data.quote: The third application went through in nine days.
body: I had been refused twice and was ready to give up. During Transfiguration Night I wrote my request and brought it to the altar online.
Nine days after I applied again, it was approved. God changed the outcome.

data.title: Our twins arrived safely
data.name: Emeka & Joy O.
data.quote: After seven years of waiting, we held our twins.
body: We joined the prayer line every Friday for a year. Today we came back to say thank you, holding two babies.

data.title: Healed after three years of back pain
data.name: Grace N.
data.quote: I stood up from my seat during the Sunday service without the pain I had carried for three years.
body: For three years I could not sit for more than twenty minutes. Doctors gave me exercises and painkillers, and I did everything they said.
On Sunday the Prophet prayed for everyone watching who had pain in their back. I put my hand where it hurt and said Amen. When I stood up at the end of the service, the pain was gone.
I give God all the glory.
